---
title: "Projects"
---

There are two group projects. Group size may be 1, 2, or 3 students, with expectations scaled by group size.

| Project | Due | Focus | Weight |
|---|---|---|---:|
| [Project 1](project-1-eda.qmd) | Week 9 | Exploratory data analysis | 10% |
| [Project 2](project-2-modeling.qmd) | Week 15 | Modeling and communication | 10% |

## Shared Requirements

Every project must include:

- a clear question;
- a description and citation of the dataset;
- reproducible code;
- labeled figures and tables;
- interpretation in context;
- validation checks;
- an AI-use appendix.

## Suggested Rubric

| Criterion | Weight |
|---|---:|
| Problem formulation and data understanding | 20% |
| Computational correctness | 25% |
| Validation, diagnostics, and reproducibility | 25% |
| Communication and visualization quality | 20% |
| Responsible AI-use appendix | 10% |
